title: Fix doubled TASK- prefix in branch names (sprint-N-task-TASK-NNN-slug)
description:
Orchestrator builds task branches as `sprint-{N}-task-{taskId}-{slug}` where taskId already contains the 'TASK-' prefix, producing cosmetic doubling like `sprint-4-task-TASK-001-bootstrap-repo-scaffold`. Discovered during TASK-020 live acceptance test against issues-plugin.

Fix: strip leading 'TASK-' from taskId before interpolating into branch template, OR change template to `sprint-{N}-{taskId}-{slug}`. Latter is cleaner but renames branch convention. Former is a 2-line fix in scripts/branch-setup.mjs and the merge-task.mjs branch-name logic.
acceptance_criteria: New branches created as `sprint-{N}-task-NNN-{slug}` (single TASK- removed) OR `sprint-{N}-{taskId}-{slug}` (full id, no extra task- prefix).
Existing branches with old naming continue to work (merge-task can still find/merge them).
Decision documented in commit message: which of the two patterns chosen and why.
Tests for branch-setup updated to reflect new pattern.
